description: Get full information and scorecard for a single cricket match (Test/ODI/T20) by its match ID. Returns teams, venue, innings scores, toss, and winner. Get the id from current_matches.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CricAPI key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

id.description: Match ID, as returned by current_matches.
